senses.name: playerAway
senses.value: 7 when Tony is in another room, else 0
senses.derived_from: currentChamberNumber against the clone's room; not in the twenty raw senses

senses.name: routeDx
senses.value: while playerAway: the sign and bucket (as dx, 0 under 8 px ... 7 from 128) of the distance from the clone to the route point, the foot of the ladder that leads to Tony's room (its columns' centre); 0 when not away
senses.derived_from: the clone's X and the ladder column of the room (from the seed); not in the raw senses

senses.name: routeDy
senses.value: while playerAway: the height of the route point above his feet in bricks, as dy is bucketed (the ladder's bottom rung row against his feet row); 0 when not away
senses.derived_from: the clone's Y and the ladder's bottom row

senses.name: ladderDx
senses.value: the sign and bucket of the distance to the nearest ladder in his room (its columns' centre), whether or not Tony is away; 0 when he is within the ladder's columns
senses.derived_from: the clone's X and the room's ladder columns

senses.name: ladderDy
senses.value: bricks between his feet and the nearest ladder's bottom rung, positive when the rung is above him, bucketed as dy; 0 when he is on or beside it
senses.derived_from: the clone's Y and the ladder's bottom row
